finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache-miss load killed the app.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | Cache miss storm, reads hit the store direct |
| 02:15:26 | Reconnects start. 13 tries, all refused |
| 02:29:12 | `request queue depth 502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`, `worker-2` dies code 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back. Reconnects were flat at 80s apart with no backoff and no give-up. 173 store timeouts and 174 cache miss storms in between.

Next: check why Redis went down. Then add a circuit breaker so a cold cache cannot queue the app to death.
